newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-ATLETICO COACH ANTIC SUSPENDED FOR INSULTING REFEREE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ATLETICO COACH ANTIC SUSPENDED FOR INSULTING REFEREE.

text.p: The Spanish league disciplinary committee has suspended Radomir Antic for a game for insulting the referee after Atletico Madrid's dramatic game with Athletic Bilbao on Sunday.

"This is the partiality of Spanish justice," said Antic, who had called the referee 'shameless'. The same insult during last season's game at Real Sociedad also produced a one-game ban for the Atletico coach.
Antic complained bitterly about refereeing decisions in the 1-1 draw, which he insisted cost Atletico two penalties.
But there was some good news for the league champions, as the committtee decided to withdraw one of the yellow cards which cost Czech midfielder Radek Bejbl a sending-off during the game.

Atletico are also producing a defence for Diego Simeone after the Bilbao side complained about a challenge in which the Argentine international stamped on Athletic's Julen Guerrero. If found guilty of intentional aggression, Simeone could be banned for up to 12 games.
